title: mixcore core API v0.2: discovery listener message
description: Delivered once per Discover call, from the discovery goroutine. status failed means no probe could be sent at all (error ERR_NETWORK: no socket, or every send refused, for example Local Network access denied); consoles is then empty. A target that did not answer is simply absent. v0.2: the core tells the family of a reply apart by its source port and its model string: a reply from 10023 is x32 and one from 10024 is xair, unless its model belongs to the other family (x32 models of X32-F11 such as X32, X32RACK, M32; xair models start with XR, X18 or MR, V2 suffixes included, XA-F70); from any other port the model decides. A reply whose port and model contradict each other, or that is of another family than the one requested, is not listed. v0.3: the built-in demo mixer (StartDemo) is never listed, even when its loopback address is probed as a manual host or the demo is stopped while the probe runs: the core filters every address a demo of this engine has used.

host.description: Address the reply came from; pass it to Start as host.

name.description: Network name the console reports (user content).
